faqs.question: What is a normal adult weight range for a French Bulldog?
faqs.answer: This breed record lists 16-28 lb (7-13 kg). Your veterinarian sets the target for the individual using body condition, not only the breed average.

faqs.question: Which health issues should I watch for in a senior French Bulldog?
faqs.answer: This stage guide highlights Brachycephalic obstructive airway syndrome (BOAS); Intervertebral disc disease (IVDD) risk. Use the linked symptom pages for red flags, then contact your clinic.

faqs.question: How often should I weigh my French Bulldog at this stage?
faqs.answer: At least every 30 days for a senior French Bulldog, sooner if appetite, thirst, or mobility changes.
